entry.title: Anamika Dubey delivered the 2026 Anjan Bose Lecture, “Engineering Resilient Power Grid: From Understanding Risk to In...
entry.content: Anamika Dubey delivered the 2026 Anjan Bose Lecture, “Engineering Resilient Power Grid: From Understanding Risk to Informing Decisions,” at WSU in Pullman. The lecture explored how outage data, vulnerability models, and optimization can inform decisions about extreme-weather risk and power-grid resilience, including emerging challenges in the Pacific Northwest. Lecture details.

entry.title: Anamika Dubey is scheduled to join the panel “AI Infrastructures: It’s Really an Energy Race” at the WTIA AI Summit o...
entry.content: Anamika Dubey is scheduled to join the panel “AI Infrastructures: It’s Really an Energy Race” at the WTIA AI Summit on October 27, 2026, at Bell Harbor International Conference Center in Seattle. The panel will discuss AI infrastructure growth and its implications for energy and the power grid. Summit details.

entry.title: Shiva Poudel was invited to present “Increasing Grid Utilization Through Stochastic Operating Envelopes and Asset-Awa...
entry.content: Shiva Poudel was invited to present “Increasing Grid Utilization Through Stochastic Operating Envelopes and Asset-Aware Controls” at the WSU–PNNL Advanced Grid Institute seminar on September 30, 2026. The announced talk focused on using stochastic operating envelopes, asset-aware optimal power flow, and large-scale simulation to unlock capacity from existing distribution grids.

entry.title: Anamika Dubey helped host AGI Day 2026 at WSU Tri-Cities in Richland, Washington. The theme, “Intelligent Grids at Sc...
entry.content: Anamika Dubey helped host AGI Day 2026 at WSU Tri-Cities in Richland, Washington. The theme, “Intelligent Grids at Scale: Serving rapid demand growth while preserving reliability and affordability,” brought researchers and industry leaders together to discuss AI, data-center load growth, grid resilience, and research deployment. Event details.

entry.title: Rabayet Sadnan won the 2026 IEEE PES Outstanding Doctoral Dissertation Award for his research on scalable, privacy-pr...
entry.content: Rabayet Sadnan won the 2026 IEEE PES Outstanding Doctoral Dissertation Award for his research on scalable, privacy-preserving distributed optimal power flow for grid-edge coordination, advised by Anamika Dubey.

entry.title: Rabayet Sadnan and Anamika Dubey, with colleagues, taught “Advances in Distribution Optimal Power Flow (DOPF): Theory...
entry.content: Rabayet Sadnan and Anamika Dubey, with colleagues, taught “Advances in Distribution Optimal Power Flow (DOPF): Theory, Implementation, and Applications” at the IEEE PES General Meeting in Montréal, Canada. The tutorial included hands-on distribution-system optimization with open-source tools. Official program · DistOPF tutorial notebook.

entry.title: Lusha Wang and Anamika Dubey, with a collaborator, published Linearized Optimal Power Flow for Multi-Phase Meshed Unb...
entry.content: Lusha Wang and Anamika Dubey, with a collaborator, published Linearized Optimal Power Flow for Multi-Phase Meshed Unbalanced Power Distribution Systems in IEEE Transactions on Smart Grid. The work develops linearized power-flow and optimization models for unbalanced distribution systems with meshed networks and diverse transformer configurations.
